name: On-canvas pixel light bulb gizmo controls light direction with live shading preview
description: Verify triggering photometric lighting activates the on-canvas light bulb gizmo and top action bar, and pressing cancel restores the canvas.

planSteps.description: Click the Ellipse tool button in the left toolbar or press the O key
Click on the center drawing canvas (main composite canvas) to draw a circular shape
Click the PixiBud AI tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the Analyze & Render button in the 2.5D Photometric Studio
Verify the on-canvas light bulb gizmo appears with a directional light handle and action bar
Click the Cancel button in the on-canvas light gizmo action bar
Verify the on-canvas light bulb gizmo and action bar are dismissed
